title: So disappointed
text:
So disappointed. This is my 3rd peeler from this company and the same brand.
1st peeler was so wonderful, but I wore it out
2nd peeler cut so deep, it left deep groves in the potatoes to the point, you had to peel extra to make up for the lost potato
3rd and their NEW model, is a total mess, the cutter works fine, but the arm that adjusts the height of the potato, it doesn't raise and lower smoothly, it catches on the groves on the post. As you're raising the arm to get to the top of the potato, before you can even stick the prong into the potato, it start twirling the potato, which half the time it throws the potato off the machine.
Why do they have to fix what isn't broken, I guess if they come out with a new machine, you'll want the newest and will buy it.
They said that the holder on the bottom, that holds the potato is now removable, big deal, the old one was so easy to clean, it didn't need to be removed, because it was attached to the base and there is no opening to clean.
What a mess they have made of a wonderful product.
BTW, there is no way to adjust the arm with the blade, that's why the machine that cut so deep, couldn't be adjusted.
